description: tool_index package installs in editable mode and is importable
steps: Run pip install -e . from tool_index/
Run python -c 'import tool_index; print(tool_index.__name__)'
Verify output is tool_index with no ImportError

description: config.loader loads configs/default.yaml into a typed PipelineConfig
steps: Run python -c 'from tool_index.config import default_config; c = default_config(); print(c)'
Verify no exception and the returned object exposes pipeline/cluster/validation sections

description: providers.llm_fake and providers.embedding_fake instantiate without network
steps: Run python -c 'from tool_index.providers.llm_fake import FakeLLM; from tool_index.providers.embedding_fake import FakeEmbedder; FakeLLM(); FakeEmbedder()'
Verify no exception and both classes construct with default args

description: python -m tool_index build --help prints usage
steps: Run python -m tool_index build --help
Verify exit code 0 and output contains --config, --input, --output flags

description: Stage 1 normalizes raw tool dicts into ToolDescriptor objects and dedupes
steps: Load tests/fixtures/mini_tools.json
Call pipeline.stage1_normalize.normalize_and_dedupe with the raw list
Verify every returned item is a ToolDescriptor with a stable id
Verify duplicate input rows collapse to a single descriptor

description: Stage 2 enriches each descriptor with intent phrase, IO kinds, synonyms, examples
steps: Run stage2_enrich.enrich_descriptors on the Stage 1 output with FakeLLM
Verify each returned ToolDescriptor has enrichment.intent, io_kinds, synonyms, examples populated

description: Stage 3 groups enriched tools into L3 leaf clusters via HDBSCAN/agglomerative fallback
steps: Run stage3_cluster_leaves.cluster_leaves with FakeEmbedder on enriched tools
Verify every tool is assigned to exactly one L3 cluster id
Verify cluster sizes fall within configured min/max bounds after rebalance

description: Stage 4 clusters L3 → L2 → L1 based on child description embeddings
steps: Run stage4_cluster_upward.cluster_upward on L3 clusters
Verify output has distinct L1 and L2 levels with parent pointers
Verify every L3 cluster has an L2 parent and every L2 has an L1 parent

description: labeling.contrastive and labeling.describe produce node titles/descriptions via LLM
steps: Run labeling.describe.describe_node on a cluster with FakeLLM
Verify the returned node has a non-empty title and description
Run labeling.contrastive.contrastive_refine on sibling clusters and verify titles differ

description: Stage 5 structural validator checks parent/child integrity and depth bounds
steps: Build a tree via Stages 1–4 on mini_tools
Run validation.structural.validate_structure on the tree
Verify it returns a report with errors=[] for a well-formed tree

description: Stage 5 sibling discriminability check flags overlapping sibling descriptions
steps: Run validation.discriminability.check_siblings on a built tree
Verify it returns per-parent cosine-similarity scores for sibling titles
Verify scores below the configured threshold produce warnings in the report

description: Stage 5 generates synthetic queries and measures recall@k against the tree
steps: Run validation.synthetic_queries.generate on the tree with FakeLLM
Run validation.recall_benchmark.evaluate with the generated queries
Verify the report contains recall@1, recall@5, recall@10 numeric values

description: Stage 6 writes an immutable versioned snapshot with tree.json, build_trace.json, seed_eval_set.jsonl
steps: Run stage6_freeze.freeze on a validated tree with out_root=<tmp>/snapshots
Verify <tmp>/snapshots/<version>/tree.json exists
Verify <tmp>/snapshots/<version>/build_trace.json exists
Verify <tmp>/snapshots/<version>/seed_eval_set.jsonl exists

description: retrieval.traverser descends L1 → L2 → L3 → tool for a query and returns candidate tools
steps: Load a frozen snapshot with storage.snapshot.load
Run retrieval.traverser.traverse with query='read a user row' and k=5
Verify returned list has ≤5 ToolDescriptors and includes db_users_read

description: pipeline.orchestrator.build_tree_index runs all six stages on mini_tools and returns a valid tree
steps: Run build_tree_index(mini_tools, default_config(), out_root=<tmp>/snapshots, strict=False)
Verify returned tree.depth() is 4 or 5
Verify every non-root node has a parent_id that resolves in tree.nodes_by_id
Verify every tool id is reachable by walking root→children

description: python -m tool_index build end-to-end writes a snapshot directory
steps: Run python -m tool_index build --config configs/default.yaml --input tests/fixtures/mini_tools.json --output <tmp>/snapshots
Verify exit code 0
Verify <tmp>/snapshots/<version>/tree.json exists and parses as JSON

description: utils.ids and utils.hashing produce identical output across runs for identical inputs
steps: Run utils.hashing.stable_hash on the same dict twice and verify equal
Run utils.ids.tool_id on the same descriptor twice and verify equal
Build the tree twice with the same seed and verify tree.version matches

description: clustering.noise_handling reassigns HDBSCAN noise points to nearest cluster
steps: Construct an embedding set where HDBSCAN marks some points as noise (label=-1)
Run noise_handling.reassign_noise
Verify no point retains label=-1 in the output

description: clustering.rebalance splits clusters exceeding max_size and merges undersize ones
steps: Run clustering.rebalance.rebalance on a cluster assignment with an oversize cluster
Verify no output cluster exceeds the configured max_size
Verify no output cluster is smaller than min_size (or is merged into a sibling)

description: Stage 1 raises on raw tool dicts missing name or signature
steps: Call normalize_and_dedupe with [{'doc': 'no name'}]
Verify a ValidationError (or equivalent) is raised mentioning the missing field

description: build_tree_index(strict=True) raises ValidationError when Stage 5 reports errors
steps: Construct an input guaranteed to produce a structural violation (e.g. one tool)
Run build_tree_index(..., strict=True)
Verify ValidationError is raised and no snapshot is written

description: All unit tests under tests/unit/ pass
steps: Run pytest tests/unit/ -x from tool_index/
Verify exit code 0 and no failures

description: tests/integration/test_pipeline_mini.py passes end-to-end
steps: Run pytest tests/integration/test_pipeline_mini.py -x from tool_index/
Verify exit code 0
